blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-08. The current Terms of Service dated 27 August 2026 disclaim issuer power to freeze, burn, seize, or alter USDu/sUSDu in user wallets; interface suspension is separate. This supersedes the adverse issuer-legal-power claim recorded on 2026-08-08. Re-read verified BSC USDu.sol and inherited ERC-20 code: holder transfers are standard, burns require the holder or allowance, and owner-only minter replacement creates issuance power without a holder blacklist, seizure, pause, or token upgrade path. At finalized Solana slot 454577487, getAccountInfo returned freezeAuthority=null and only metadataPointer/tokenMetadata extensions, with no transfer hook or permanent delegate. Active mint authority remains a separate issuance risk. Upstream exposure also reviewed: Unitas documents WBTC, JLP (including USDC/USDT), and Copper/Ceffu off-exchange custody. HT Digital's 25 September sighting names BTC $36.241m, JLP $11.263m, USD1 $3.352m, BSC-USD $1.647m, U $0.435m, BNB $0.388m, and Other assets -$0.709m. It does not identify the BTC representation/custodian, map assets to custody rails, or reconcile all deployments; CEX balances include unrealised margin PnL. These facts establish upstream risk but do not establish full CEX custody or a non-overlapping issuer/custodian-controlled reserve share strictly above 50%, as required for Upstream by the current FreezeWatch policy. Retain No as no qualifying exposure resolved under that policy, not as proof of zero upstream risk; revisit when instrument/custody weights resolve the threshold.

oracleRisk.summary: USDu is issued against a protocol-managed delta-neutral reserve portfolio rather than borrower debt positions with oracle-triggered collateral liquidation.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: Unitas's protocol-managed delta-neutral portfolio uses collateral and hedge marks to monitor margin, PnL, exposure, and liquidity, with bots rebalancing hedge sizes about hourly to keep net exposure aligned. Those internal market-value inputs affect the top-level redemption and reserve operation; USDu has no borrower-specific debt or liquidation branches, so the disposition is top-level-only.
